title: Budgeting
content: A simple rule is 50/30/20: 50% to needs (rent, utilities, food, transport), 30% to wants, 20% to savings and debt paydown. Track spending for a month first, then set limits per category. Automate savings so you save before spending. In the Philippines, breadwinners may need to allocate more to needs; aim to keep at least 10–20% for savings.
